title: Animated family of research identities
slide_intent: Reveal how different marks share one construction logic because temporal comparison can teach a family relationship more clearly than a single logo.
strategic_value: The film can express individual research identities and their membership in one institution.
demonstration: White orthogonal strokes enter and resolve into marks on black; the film alternates a multi-glyph array with enlarged named group signatures, then resolves to the lab identity.
practical_value: Study transitions between the collective array, individual groups and the institutional signature.
